Carriers of this gene regenerate their tissue at a much faster rate than normal, and are much more capable of fighting off any infections and illnesses.

Carriers of this gene grow large insect-like wings at the back of their torso, allowing them to move quicker, glide through difficult terrain with ease, and from time to time enable them to leap into the air.
Carriers of this gene have very strong, insect-like mandibles, allowing them to consume food significantly quicker. They will also be able to use these mandibles in combat if unarmed.

Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold midgut, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all. Prevents food poisoning.

Carriers of this gene are capable of absorbing new information at an incredible rate, analyzing their experiences and learning from them with ease. They are incredibly good at learning new skills and knowledge.

Carriers of this gene grow two strong horns from their forehead, similar to those found on bioengineered megaspiders. These horns can be used to maul enemies in combat if unarmed, but they also increase mining speed slightly.
Carriers of this gene have their Malpighian tubules set to overdrive and are capable of withstanding extreme amounts of toxicity without any ill effects.

Carriers of this gene do not suffer hypothermia. Instead, they enter hypothermic slowdown - a special biological state that allows them to survive extreme cold. Instead of trying to stay warm, the carrier’s body chemistry adapts to prevent internal freezing despite very low temperature. Bodily functions are slowed and capacities are reduced, but the cold does no permanent damage.
Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia, and age much slower.

Carriers of this gene have their exoskeleton consisting of thick, hardened chitin, and are much more resistant to damage and stagger effects. This comes at the cost of slowing them down slightly due to the sheer weight of the carapace.
Carriers of this gene have a volatile substance surrounding their brain, greatly increasing their psychic sensitivity.

Carriers of this gene produce large amounts of serotonin, keeping them in a continuous state of bliss while also affecting their consciousness. The presence of this neurotransmitter will also make them more aggressive.
Carriers of this gene produce a special kind of heatshock proteins when hot, allowing them to survive even the most extreme temperatures, but causing them to consume a lot more nutrition.
Carriers of this gene have large jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen, allowing them to periodically produce valuable insect jelly.

Insectors were engineered as a military project to thrive on planets with harsh, insectoid environments. They can edit their genes to form various castes suited to different conditions, making them highly adaptable and self-sufficient. Living in symbiosis with insectoids, they reproduce by implanting a chestburster larva into a host.\n\nWith chitinous exoskeletons, multifaceted eyes, and segmented limbs, Insectors resemble a blend of humans and insects. Their isolationist nature and unsettling appearance often lead others to see them as cold and unapproachable. However, their society is complex and strategic, using fear and misunderstanding to their advantage in diplomacy and warfare, ensuring their survival in the harshest conditions.

As the old, derelict ship entered the lower orbit, a sudden systems failure triggered a catastrophic malfunction. Not sure if it was due to the ship’s advanced age, a critical hardware failure, or a long-dormant virus in the AI-core, we quickly realized it didn’t matter. Our colony of insectors, long misunderstood and striving to survive, was in chaos. In our panic, we instinctively swarmed towards the escape pods, desperate to flee the impending disaster.

In our haste, we accidentally launched the pods, leaving the human crew behind in their cryptosleep chambers, unaware and doomed. The ship split into numerous chunks as it rapidly descended onto the surface. Amid the pandemonium, we could only hope that perhaps some things could still be recovered from the wreckage.

Note: Since you start crash landing and with very little supplies, this is a difficult scenario.
